skill.name: canvas-design
skill.description: Create polished static design artifacts as PNG or PDF files from a generated visual philosophy, using bundled fonts and design-first composition guidance.
skill.summary: Create polished PNG and PDF visual artwork from a clear design philosophy.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The OFL text and SKILL.md alerts are false positives caused by license wording, Markdown paths, and design guidance. No prompt injection, network access, secret access, or executable command behavior was found. The remaining risk is low-severity review of bundled binary font assets.

remediation.issue: Bundled binary font assets are not fully inspectable by static text analysis.
remediation.suggestion: Provide source URLs, checksums, and license provenance for each font, or remove fonts that are not required.

content.value_statement: Static visual requests can produce text-heavy or generic outputs. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create polished PNG or PDF artwork from a clear design philosophy.
actual_capabilities: Creates a short design philosophy before visual production.
Guides output toward single-page PNG or PDF artifacts.
Uses bundled font assets for varied typographic style.
Emphasizes minimal text, spatial composition, color, form, and hierarchy.
Supports multi-page visual series when requested.
Instructs a refinement pass for spacing, margins, and overlap checks.
limitations: Does not include executable rendering code or automation scripts.
Relies on the host AI tool to create files and inspect outputs.
Bundled fonts add package size and require asset provenance review.
Best suited for static design, not interactive media or animation.

use_cases.title: Produce Event Artwork
use_cases.description: Create a poster or single-page visual artifact with restrained text and a strong design concept.

use_cases.title: Explore Visual Directions
use_cases.description: Generate a design philosophy that can guide abstract composition, typography, and color decisions.

use_cases.title: Make Static Learning Visuals
use_cases.description: Turn a topic into a polished visual piece that communicates through form, hierarchy, and space.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Poster
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one static artifact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a single-page poster for [topic]. Use minimal text, strong composition, and a design philosophy that fits the subject.

prompt_templates.title: Create Brand-Inspired Artwork
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with mood and format constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PNG artwork for [brand or project]. Use [mood], [colors], and only the text [required text].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Visual Series
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for multiple related pages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a three-page PDF visual series about [subject]. Keep each page distinct while following one shared design philosophy.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Refined Publication Piece
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with strict quality review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a publication-quality artifact for [audience]. Include a design philosophy, produce the final visual, then refine spacing and typography.

output_examples.input: Create a poster for a small jazz record fair.
output_examples.output: A concise design philosophy followed by a single-page PNG or PDF concept with minimal text, structured typography, and refined spacing.

output_examples.input: Create a visual piece for a ceramics studio anniversary.

best_practices: Give the subject, mood, format, and required text before invoking the skill.
Ask for one final artifact first, then request a series only when needed.
Review typography, margins, and overlap after the first render.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to imitate a living artist or copy protected work.
Do not use it for long reports, slide decks, or text-heavy documents.
Do not request interactive interfaces, animation, or production code.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates static visual artifacts, usually PNG or PDF files, guided by a short design philosophy.

faq.question: Does it make interactive designs?
faq.answer: No. It is intended for static posters, artwork, and design-forward documents.

faq.question: Can I provide required text?
faq.answer: Yes. Short required text works best because the skill treats text as a visual element.

faq.question: Does it include fonts?
faq.answer: Yes. The package includes bundled font files and license text for local typography choices.

faq.question: Is it suitable for brand work?
faq.answer: It can explore brand-adjacent visual directions, but final brand assets need human review.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
